subject: nereid-v8-hourglass
q: The even-number canon now covers bust and hips, and it moves at least one woman's band.
detail:
v8 extends the round-down rule from the waist to ALL THREE primary circumferences, with revalidation afterward. TWO WOMEN IN THE CANON CURRENTLY CARRY AN ODD PRIMARY.

SIREN at 34–25–38. Her 25-inch waist rounds DOWN to 24, which takes her WHR from 0.6579 to 0.6316 — PRONOUNCED becomes EXTREME. She passes either way; the band moves. That is the rounding bias working exactly as designed, on a real woman, in the flattering direction.

YVAINE at 37–26–38. Her 37-inch bust rounds down to 36. Separation moves from 0.0185 to 0.0380. Still Balanced, still comfortably compliant, no consequence beyond the number.

Neither is an error and neither is being changed. Both are what adoption would do.
